raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\langle \psi_ {a} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {a} \rangle = \langle \psi_ {b} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {b} \rangle = 0, \quad \langle \psi_ {a} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {b} \rangle = \langle \psi_ {b} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {a} \rangle = h,
$$

其中 $h$ 是某一给定常量.

(a) 求徽扰哈密顿量的严格本征值.   
(b) 用二阶微扰理论估算微扰系统的能量.  
(c) 用变分原理估算微扰系统的基态能量，试探波函数的形式为

$$
\psi = (\cos \phi) \psi_ {a} + (\sin \phi) \psi_ {b},
$$

其中 $\phi$ 为可调参数.注释写成线性组合的形式是保证 $\psi$ 归一化的一种简便方法.

(d) 对比 (a) (b) (c) 各部分的答案.在该情况下，为什么变分原理的结果会如此准确?
raw_problem.solution_text:
$( \mathrm { a } ) H = H ^ { 0 } + H ^ { \prime }$ 的矩阵表达式为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} E _ {a} & h \\ h & E _ {b} \end{array} \right).
$$

解久期方程，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left| \begin{array}{c c} E _ {a} - E & h \\ h & E _ {b} - E \end{array} \right| = 0 \\ \Rightarrow E ^ {2} - E \left(E _ {a} + E _ {b}\right) + E _ {a} E _ {b} - h ^ {2} = 0 \\ \Rightarrow E _ {\pm} = \frac {1}{2} \left(E _ {a} + E _ {b} \pm \sqrt {E _ {a} ^ {2} - 2 E _ {a} E _ {b} + E _ {b} ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2}}\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ E _ {a} + E _ {b} \pm \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \sqrt {1 + 4 h ^ {2} / \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) ^ {2}} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

由非简并微扰理论，能量的一阶修正为

$$
E _ {a} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} \right\rangle = 0, \quad E _ {b} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} \right\rangle = 0.
$$

二阶修正为

$$
E _ {a} ^ {2} = \frac {\left| \langle \psi_ {b} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \right. \psi_ {a} \left. \right\rangle\left. \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {a} - E _ {b}} = - \frac {h ^ {2}}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}},
$$

$$
E _ {b} ^ {2} = \frac {\left| \langle \psi_ {a} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \right. \psi_ {b} \left. \right\rangle\left. \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}} = \frac {h ^ {2}}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}}.
$$

于是三阶微扰理论下的微扰系统能量为

$$
E _ {-} = E _ {a} - \frac {h ^ {2}}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}}, \quad E _ {+} = E _ {b} + \frac {h ^ {2}}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}}.
$$

(c) 用变分原理方法，我们需求出在试探披函数下 $H$ 的期望值

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle H \rangle = \left\langle \cos \phi \psi_ {a} + \sin \phi \psi_ {b} \right| \left(H ^ {0} + H ^ {\prime}\right) \left| \cos \phi \psi_ {a} + \sin \phi \psi_ {b} \right\rangle \\ = E _ {a} \cos^ {2} \phi + E _ {b} \sin^ {2} \phi + 2 h \sin \phi \cos \phi , \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi} \left\langle H \right\rangle = \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \sin 2 \phi + 2 h \cos 2 \phi = 0 \Rightarrow \tan 2 \phi \\ = - \frac {2 h}{E _ {b} - E _ {a}} \equiv - \varepsilon . \\ \end{array}
$$

利用三角函数之间的关系，

$$
\sin 2 \phi = \frac {\pm \varepsilon}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}, \cos 2 \phi = \frac {\mp 1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}},
$$

$$
\cos^ {2} \phi = \frac {1}{2} (1 + \cos 2 \phi) = \frac {1}{2} \left(1 \mp \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}\right),
$$

$$
\sin^ {2} \phi = \frac {1}{2} \left(1 - \cos 2 \phi\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(1 \pm \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}\right).
$$

代入即可得到能量的极值

$$
\langle H \rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left(E _ {a} + E _ {b} \pm \sqrt {E _ {a} ^ {2} - 2 E _ {a} E _ {b} + E _ {b} ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2}}\right).
$$

根号前为正号对应极大值，负号对应极小值，所以

$$
\langle H \rangle_ {\mathrm {m i n}} = \frac {1}{2} \left(E _ {a} + E _ {b} - \sqrt {E _ {a} ^ {2} - 2 E _ {a} E _ {b} + E _ {b} ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2}}\right).
$$

(d) 当微扰 $h \ll E _ { b } - E _ { a }$ 时，但)中的精确解可展开为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {1}{2} \left[ E _ {a} + E _ {b} \pm \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \sqrt {1 + 4 h ^ {2} / \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) ^ {2}} \right] \\ \approx \frac {1}{2} \left\{E _ {a} + E _ {b} \pm \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \left[ 1 + 2 h ^ {2} / \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) ^ {2} \right] \right\} \\ \approx \left\{ \begin{array}{l} E _ {b} + h ^ {2} / (E _ {b} - E _ {a}) \\ E _ {a} - h ^ {2} / (E _ {b} - E _ {a}) \end{array} \right.. \\ \end{array}
$$

这与 (b) 中用微扰理论计算的结果一致. (c) 用变分原理得到的基态能量与精确解完全一致，这是因为所选取的试探波函数已是最一般的波函数形式.自变分法确定基态 $\phi$ $\sin { \phi }$ 的值，正好是由本征方程解出精确的基态披函数的叠加系数.证明如下:由能量本征方程

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left( \begin{array}{c c} E _ {a} & h \\ h & E _ {b} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} c _ {a} \\ c _ {b} \end{array} \right) = E _ {-} \left( \begin{array}{c} c _ {a} \\ c _ {b} \end{array} \right) \\ \Rightarrow c _ {b} = \frac {E _ {-} - E _ {a}}{h} c _ {a}. \\ \end{array}
$$

归一化，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left| c _ {a} \right| ^ {2} + \left| c _ {b} \right| ^ {2} = 1 \Rightarrow \left| c _ {a} \right| ^ {2} \left(1 + \left| \frac {E _ {-} - E _ {a}}{h} \right| ^ {2}\right) = 1 \\ \Rightarrow c _ {a} = \frac {h}{\sqrt {\left(E _ {a} - E _ {-}\right) ^ {2} + h ^ {2}}}, \quad c _ {b} = - \frac {E _ {a} - E _ {-}}{\sqrt {\left(E _ {a} - E _ {-}\right) ^ {2} + h ^ {2}}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

将上式代入 $c _ { a }$ 与 $c _ { b }$ ，的关系式，得

$$
E _ {-} = \frac {1}{2} \left[ E _ {a} + E _ {b} - \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} \right],
$$

$$
E _ {a} - E _ {-} = E _ {a} - \frac {1}{2} \left[ E _ {a} + E _ {b} - \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} \right] = \frac {1}{2} \left(E _ {b} - E _ {a}\right) \left(\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1\right).
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} c _ {a} = \frac {h}{\sqrt {\frac {1}{4} (E _ {b} - E _ {a}) ^ {2} (\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1) ^ {2} + h ^ {2}}} = \frac {2 h / (E _ {b} - E _ {a})}{\sqrt {(\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1) ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2} / (E _ {b} - E _ {a}) ^ {2}}} \\ = \frac {\varepsilon}{\sqrt {\left(\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1\right) ^ {2} + \varepsilon^ {2}}} = \frac {\varepsilon}{\sqrt {2 \left(1 + \varepsilon^ {2}\right) + 2 \sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}} \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \frac {\varepsilon}{(1 + \varepsilon^ {2}) ^ {1 / 4}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}} + 1} \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \frac {\varepsilon}{(1 + \varepsilon^ {2}) ^ {1 / 4}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} + 1}} \frac {\sqrt {\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1}}{\sqrt {\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}} - 1}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \sqrt {1 - \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同样可以求出

$$
c _ {b} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}}.
$$

精确的基态波函数为 $\psi = c _ { a } \psi _ { a } + c _ { b } \psi _ { b }$

与基态对应的 $\cos \phi$ , sin rþ 分别为

$$
\cos \phi = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \sqrt {1 - \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}}, \quad \sin \phi = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + \varepsilon^ {2}}}}.
$$

变分法得出的 $\cos \phi$ $\sin { \phi }$ 值正好是精确解的叠加系数，这样变分法能得到精确的基态能量也就不奇怪了.
